title: Retrieval close record runtime event payload v0.2
description: ADR-0010 §4.4/§5.2: mechanical receipt of the close commit (terminal record + live-state reset are one commit). normal_close must reference a validated decision=close disposition (verifier cross-check); termination authorities reference cancel/failure/wallclock reasons instead. auto_close (THIN-HARNESS-REDESIGN R1, 2026-08-27): every dispatch closes its activation immediately after result formation + assessment (no disposition round-trip). subagent_timeout (RETRIEVAL-ORCHESTRATION-MECHANICAL 0k, 2026-08-30): the retrieval subagent run-level wallclock budget exhausted mid-run — activation closes resumable with no assessment/digest. RETRIEVAL-BATCH-HANDOFF-AND-ROUND-SEAT 0ar S1 (2026-09-19, design v1.0 §7/§8): three normal-close reasons of the batch-handoff contract — evidence_threshold_met (D1: the subagent self-judged the usable-evidence target met and produced its result summary), dispatch_wallclock_bound (D2: the per-batch wallclock bound expired; the batch hands back partial evidence + gap normally, never as subagent_failed — its obtained-count/gap readings ride the referenced information_sufficiency_assessment, hence the assessment-chain requirement below), subagent_early_delivery (D1 §3.7: the subagent delivered early below target; a missing evidence pointer fails open to a normal close + anomaly, so no schema requirement rides this value).

effort.description: RETRIEVAL-ORCHESTRATION-MECHANICAL 0k 第二批 (2026-08-30): 委托契约复杂度档（机械分档；可选——旧 journal 与恢复激活不携带）。
